meta.title: Zhangshi · Dialog Ledger
meta.description: Records every AI–human dialog turn into a local ledger (JSONL entries, verbatim originals, weekly Excel workbooks) so that the ledger and the verbatim originals reconcile. Ships 3 read-only agent tools and 7 read-only panel APIs; zero dependencies, offline, no model calls, no context injection; default ledger root is the desktop folder "会话账本". "Zhangshi" (账实) means "ledger matches reality" — the core test in auditing. v1.0.0 stable.
